//: Perf smoke config (perf.mjs). The demos come from the root Makefile (make list). Each demo runs once per entry in 'modes' (IRISGL_RAST / ?rast=: 'gles' GPU, the default; 'ref' CPU is the reference rasterizer, for correctness, not speed, so it is left out) for 'warmupSamples' one-second windows that are dropped, then 'seconds' that are measured; a run WARNs when its slowest one-second window is under 'warnFps'. 'startSeconds' is how long to wait for a demo's first frame. 'chromiumArgs' ask for the hardware GPU and keep timers unthrottled (web only; the report prints the WebGL renderer it got). 'demos' overrides 'modes' per demo (by id: ep-1994-decomp).
